entries.proposition: Design: public blood expression data (34 medication-free epilepsy cases, 50 controls) to pick autophagy genes, machine-learning classifiers, then LiCl-pilocarpine rats given the HIF-1 alpha translation inhibitor KC7F2 into the lateral ventricle. No oxygen exposure; WWOX not named.
entries.snippet: consisting of 50 and 34 blood samples obtained from healthy subjects (control group) and medication-free individuals with EP (EP group), respectively, was selected as the training set

entries.proposition: The 'validation' set is a different tissue and population: 129 hippocampal specimens from patients operated for mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, against a blood-based training set.
entries.snippet: includes 129 Hip specimens obtained from patients undergoing selective amygdalo-hippocampectomy for mesial temporal lobe epilepsy

entries.proposition: Model performance: AUCs 0.793, 0.807, 0.813 and 0.773 in cross-validation on the training data; the external check reports AUC 0.793.
entries.snippet: The AUC values calculated for each model were 0.793, 0.807, 0.813, and 0.773 for RF, SVM, XGB, and GLM, respectively.

entries.proposition: Core gene claim: HIF-1 alpha rises and BNIP3 falls in epileptic rat hippocampus at n = 4 per group.
entries.snippet: unlike the control group, HIF-1α was mainly located in the Hip (CA1 region) and was significantly overexpressed
entries.anchor: Results, Validating the Implication of HIF-1α/BNIP3

entries.proposition: Intervention effect on seizures: KC7F2 prolonged latency to the first grade 4 seizure but did not change the number of spontaneous seizures.
entries.snippet: there were no significant variations in SRS count within 1 week among these groups
entries.anchor: Results, Impact of HIF-1α Suppression on Seizure Susceptibility

entries.proposition: The Discussion reverses this: it says HIF-1 alpha inhibition 'reduced the number of SRS', contradicting the Results sentence above.
entries.snippet: demonstrating that HIF-1α inhibition effectively mitigated neuronal damage and reduced the number of SRS

entries.proposition: KC7F2 was given 24 hours before pilocarpine, so the latency effect is a pre-treatment effect on acute induction, not treatment of established epilepsy.
entries.snippet: the LiCl-Pilo EP model was constructed 24h after KC7F2/DMSO injection

entries.proposition: Autophagy markers: LC3 II/I is higher and p62 lower in LiCl-Pilo; both reverse with KC7F2 (LC3 II/I down, p62 up).
entries.snippet: LC3 II/I was repressed in the Hip of KC7F2 + Pilo rats

entries.proposition: Neuron and mitochondrial protection is read from H&E and Nissl counts and electron-microscopy mitochondrial area, with n = 4 per group.
entries.snippet: KC7F2 inhibition significantly improved the average mitochondrial area of Hip neurons

entries.proposition: The Discussion calls the work 'the first mechanistic evidence' while the paper's own limitations list that the relation of HIF-1 alpha/BNIP3 to autophagy is not thoroughly investigated and that human samples are needed.
entries.snippet: the potential relationship between the HIF-1α/BNIP3 pathway and Apg has not been thoroughly investigated

entries.proposition: Count of the DE-ATGs: the Results say eleven genes but list ten names.
entries.snippet: we obtained 11 identical DE-ATGs by intersecting these DEGs with the 222 ATGs, including FADD, BNIP3, CTSD, ERBB2, HIF-1α, GNAI3, CASP8/4, MAP1LC3A, NLRC4, and DAPK2

entries.proposition: Figure 11G and H (HE and Nissl counts): LiCl-Pilo about 6 and about 3 neurons per 0.1 mm2 against control about 62 and about 75, KC7F2 about 33 and about 40; Figure 8A and B (same LiCl-Pilo versus control comparison, earlier cohort) read about 30 and about 20 against about 72 and about 55. The same group therefore shows roughly five-fold different neuron counts between Figure 8 and Figure 11.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 8 A-B bars HE-stained and Nissl-stained neurons per 0.1 mm2; Figure 11 G-H bars with *** and ## significance marks.

entries.proposition: Figures 1 to 5, 7 and 8 and Figures 6, 9, 10 and 11 opened: flow chart; volcano, Venn and heat map; GO and KEGG bubble plots with HIF-1 signalling highlighted; correlation and hub network with HIF1A and BNIP3 boxed; residual and ROC plots (staircase ROC suggests a small test fold; the validation AUC of 0.793 carries a 0.587 to 0.953 interval); nomogram, calibration and decision curves; EEG traces, immunofluorescence, RT-qPCR and blots (control and treated lanes), co-immunoprecipitation (BNIP3 band in the HIF-1 alpha pull-down), KC7F2 time course, latency bar (about 19, 21 and 40 min) and spontaneous seizure count bars (about 3 per week in all groups).
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5D ROC AUC 0.793 95 percent CI 0.587-0.953; Figure 10A latency bars; Figure 10B seizure-count bars ns; Figure 9B Co-IP bands.
